import numpy as np, itertools
eps=df['eps'].values;T=df['T'].values;s=df['sigma'].values
lib={}
for a in np.arange(-2,3.01,0.25):
    ea=eps**a
    for q in np.arange(-3,3.01,0.25):
        lib[('pow',round(a,2),round(q,2))]=ea*T**q
        lib[('expT',round(a,2),round(q,2))]=ea*np.exp(q*T)
        lib[('expinvT',round(a,2),round(q,2))]=ea*np.exp(q/T)
        lib[('expeps',round(a,2),round(q,2))]=ea*np.exp(q*eps)
keys=list(lib); M=np.column_stack([lib[k] for k in keys])
results=[]
for k in [0.5,0.75,1,1.5,2,3]:
    base=np.column_stack([np.tanh(k*eps), eps*np.log(eps)*T**1.5, np.ones_like(eps)])
    # project out base
    Q,_=np.linalg.qr(base)
    Mr=M-Q@(Q.T@M)
    sr=s-Q@(Q.T@s)
    nrm=np.sum(Mr**2,axis=0)+1e-30
    coef=(Mr.T@sr)/nrm
    rss1=np.sum(sr**2)-coef**2*nrm  # residual after single extra
    top=np.argsort(rss1)[:15]
    for i in top:
        # second
        B=np.column_stack([base,M[:,i]])
        Q2,_=np.linalg.qr(B)
        Mr2=M-Q2@(Q2.T@M); sr2=s-Q2@(Q2.T@s)
        n2=np.sum(Mr2**2,axis=0)+1e-30
        c2=(Mr2.T@sr2)/n2
        rss2=np.sum(sr2**2)-c2**2*n2
        j=np.argmin(rss2)
        results.append((rss2[j]/np.sum((s-s.mean())**2),k,keys[i],keys[j]))
results.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
for r in results[:8]: print(r)
